# edh-c-78 (Commander EDHREC ranks 18,001-18,500, later pass): a counter trigger about ~ with "it", a color-and-creature-type identity with base power and toughness for as long as the object has a counter, an optional redirection of creature damage to you, a guarded put onto the battlefield, a hexproof waiver for opponents, each object entering tapped, "excess damage was dealt to a creature".
